sentences.text: DRUG INTERACTION PRECAUTION: Since oral iron products interfere with absorption of oral tetracycline antibiotics, these products should not be taken within two hours of each other.
WARNINGS: Do not exceed recommended dosage.
Occasional gastrointestinal discomfort (such as nausea) may be minimized by taking with meals.
As with any drug, if you are pregnant or nursing a baby, seek the advice of a health professional before using this product.
RDA* Elemental Iron 65 mg (Equivalent to 325 mg of Ferrous Sulfate) 60 *U.S.
